name: Transaction Silver Amalgamation & Writer Consolidation
description: `s3://opal-data-inf/silver/transactions/{date}.parquet` has two live daily writers producing disjoint schemas and different semantics, racing last-writer-wins on one key: the gold-chain REST `convert_transactions_to_silver.py` (full-history snapshot) and the `inf-api-txn` Lambda's Custom-Report path (`convert_orion_api_to_silver.build_transactions`, 1-day slice). No single project ever held all three historical transaction-pull lineages in view -- a scope gap, not a designed dual-writer. This project establishes ONE canonical writer by AMALGAMATION: `convert_transactions_to_silver.py` (REST, full-history) becomes the sole `silver/transactions/` writer and absorbs every Custom-Report-unique column via a left-join onto the REST spine by Orion transaction id. The `inf-api-txn` Lambda is TRIMMED (silver-write step removed -- kills the dual-writer; Custom-Report bronze pull retained as the join's enrichment source; aggregator-quorum sentinel retained), NOT retired. Completes the ADVI_DWSPLT TO-3 consumer migration (INF_D_05.activity_scan confirmed miss + INF_D_00 verify-clean). Resolution shape per Andrew directive 2026-05-15: 'I want all custom-report-unique fields -- anything that is unique we want to keep because may use it in the future' (forward-looking data preservation, Rule-17-aligned).
